name: ddos-detected
title: AWS Shield has detected a possible DDoS attack
description: AWS Shield Advanced has detected possible distributed denial-of-service activity against an application load balancer.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm to identify the affected load balancer.
Review AWS Shield, WAF and load balancer traffic for unusual request volume or attack indicators.
Check service availability and monitor for any ongoing impact or service degradation.
If there is an impact on service availability, an incident is likely to be raised, so escalate it ASAP.
